ARM_CFG_GROUPS.BEGIN:
# ARM (Automatic Ripping Machine) config file

#################
## ARM Options ##
#################
ARM_CFG_GROUPS.EMBY_ADDITIONAL: # Parameters to enable automatic library scan in Emby.  This will trigger only if MainFeature is true above.

ARM_NAME:
# Name shown for this ARM machine.
# Appears in notification titles as [Machine Name] when it is not empty.
# Useful if you run more than one ARM instance.
# Example: Living Room
ARM_CHILDREN:
# Child ARM servers listed on the Home page.
# Enter a comma-separated list of full URLs, including protocol and port.
# Example: http://192.168.0.100:8080/
# Child job lists need a login cookie on that host, or Disable UI Login set to Yes on the child.
# CORS is limited to these URLs (not a wildcard).
PREVENT_99:
# Abort the job when a DVD uses Track 99 DRM (fake titles that confuse HandBrake).
# Options: Yes or No.
# Yes: stop without ripping when 99 tracks are detected.
# No: continue and pass the disc to MakeMKV, which can hang or crash on some discs.
ARM_CHECK_UDF:
# Mount the disc first so UDF data discs are not treated as video.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Yes adds a few seconds to identify the disc but avoids ripping a data disc as video.
UMASK:
# Intended umask for files created in Raw Rip Folder, Transcode Folder, and Completed Folder.
# Example: 0o002 makes files group-writable.
# ARM does not currently apply this value. Use Set File Permissions and Permission Mode instead.
GET_VIDEO_TITLE:
# Look up a title after a DVD or Blu-ray is identified as video.
# Options: Yes or No.
# DVD: crc64 via pydvdid, then ARM's title API, then OMDb or TMDb (see Metadata Provider).
# Blu-ray: title from BDMV/META/DL/bdmt_eng.xml on the disc, then the same metadata provider.
# No leaves the disc label as the title.
ARM_API_KEY:
# Optional key for submitting titles to the ARM DVD database (Send DVDs to API).
# Leave empty if you do not submit titles.
DISABLE_LOGIN:
# Allow anyone to open the web UI without signing in.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Yes: all pages are public. Do not use this on a shared network.
# No: login is required to view jobs and change settings.
# Change the default admin password immediately.
# Restart the ARM UI after changing this.
SKIP_TRANSCODE:
# Keep MakeMKV output as the final files and skip HandBrake or FFmpeg.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Yes produces the largest, highest-quality files and uses the most storage.
# Works best with Rip Method set to MKV Titles.
# With Main Title Only also Yes, MakeMKV rips one guessed main title instead of every title.
# With Main Title Only set to No, every title in the min/max length window is ripped; the largest file is treated as the movie and others go to Extras Subfolder (or are discarded if that folder is None).
VIDEOTYPE:
# How ARM classifies a video disc for folders and naming.
# Options: Auto, Series, Movie.
# Auto uses the metadata provider result (default).
# Series or Movie forces that type when identification is wrong.
MINLENGTH:
# Ignore MakeMKV and HandBrake titles shorter than this length.
# Unit: seconds. Default: 600 (10 minutes).
MAXLENGTH:
# Ignore titles longer than this length.
# Unit: seconds. Use 99999 for no practical maximum.
MANUAL_WAIT:
# Pause after identification so you can change the title in the UI.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Yes only waits when the drive is in Manual mode.
# Auto-mode drives skip this wait even if this is Yes.
# Wait length is Manual Wait Time seconds.
MANUAL_WAIT_TIME:
# How long to wait for a manual title change when Wait for Manual Title applies.
# Unit: seconds.
# Also used as a delay between MakeMKV info calls when Max Concurrent Rips is not 0.
DATE_FORMAT:
# Python strftime pattern for dates in ARM and the UI.
# Example: %m-%d-%Y %H:%M:%S
ALLOW_DUPLICATES:
# Allow ripping the same disc title more than once.
# Options: Yes or No.
# No: ARM exits if it recognizes the same movie already ripped.
# Yes is recommended for TV series discs that share a title.
MAX_CONCURRENT_TRANSCODES:
# How many HandBrake or FFmpeg transcodes may run at once.
# 0 means no limit.
# Use a small number if your GPU encode slots or CPU cannot keep up.
MAX_CONCURRENT_MAKEMKVINFO:
# How many discs ARM may identify at once (makemkvcon info).
# This is the Max Concurrent Rips limit.
# 0 means no limit.
# Set to 1 if info calls crash backup or MKV rips. When this is not 0, ARM also waits Manual Wait Time seconds after each info call.
DATA_RIP_PARAMETERS:
# Extra arguments passed to dd when copying data discs.
# Example: conv=noerror,sync to ignore read errors, or status=progress to log progress.
# Leave empty for defaults.
METADATA_PROVIDER:
# Online source for movie and show names after local disc identify.
# Options: OMDb or TMDb.
# OMDb covers movies and TV (needs OMDb API Key).
# TMDb covers movies (needs TMDb API Key).
# You must set the matching API key.
GET_AUDIO_TITLE:
# How to name audio CDs.
# Options: MusicBrainz or None.
# MusicBrainz queries musicbrainz.org for artist and album.
# None leaves the disc untitled.
# freecddb appears in older docs but is not implemented.
RIP_POSTER:
# Copy a DVD jacket poster from the JACKET_P folder when one is present.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Requires FFmpeg.
AUTO_EJECT:
# Eject the disc when ripping (or the job) finishes.
# Options: Yes or No.
# No leaves the disc in the drive.
UNIDENTIFIED_EJECT:
# Present in some arm.yaml files but not read by current ARM code.
# Disc eject is controlled by Eject When Finished.
ABCDE_CONFIG_FILE:
# Path to the abcde.conf used for audio CD rips.
# Docker default: /etc/arm/config/abcde.conf
RAW_PATH:
# Folder for MakeMKV output (also the source for HandBrake or FFmpeg).
# Include a trailing slash.
TRANSCODE_PATH: # Temporary folder for HandBrake or FFmpeg output before files move to Completed Folder.
COMPLETED_PATH: # Final destination for ripped and transcoded files.
EXTRAS_SUB:
# Subfolder name under a movie folder for extra titles.
# Use None to skip extra titles when Skip Transcoding is Yes.
# Media-server examples: extras (Plex or Emby extras folder).
LOGPATH: # Folder for log files. Include a trailing slash.
LOGLEVEL:
# How much ARM writes to its logs.
# Options: Debug, Info, Warning, Error, Critical.
# Info is the default. Use Debug while troubleshooting.
LOGLIFE:
# How long to keep leftover log files before they are deleted.
# Unit: days. 0 disables automatic deletion.
# Logs still attached to jobs in History, and arm.log, are never deleted by this setting.
DBFILE: # Path to the ARM SQLite database file.
WEBSERVER_IP:
# Address the UI binds to and reports.
# Use x.x.x.x to autodetect.
WEBSERVER_PORT:
# TCP port for the ARM web UI.
# Default: 8080. Valid range: 1–65535.
UI_BASE_URL:
# Public URL used in notifications.
# Include protocol and port. Example: http://192.168.0.10:8080
SET_MEDIA_PERMISSIONS:
# After a job finishes, chmod the output files.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Mode comes from Permission Mode (for example 775).
CHMOD_VALUE:
# Octal permission mode applied when Set File Permissions is Yes.
# Use 3 or 4 octal digits. Example: 775 or 777.
SET_MEDIA_OWNER:
# After a job finishes, chown the output files.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Requires both Owner Username and Owner Group to be accounts that exist on this system.
CHOWN_USER: # System username used when Set File Owner is Yes.
CHOWN_GROUP: # System group used when Set File Owner is Yes.
MAKEMKV_PERMA_KEY:
# Purchased MakeMKV license key.
# If this is set, ARM will not try to refresh the MakeMKV beta key.
# Leave empty to use the beta key.
RIPMETHOD:
# How MakeMKV reads the disc.
# Options: MKV Titles, Blu-ray Disc Backup, or DVD Backup Extract.
# MKV Titles extracts MKV titles (used for DVDs, and for Blu-rays unless backup is selected). Combined with Main Title Only, ARM rips one guessed title instead of the whole disc.
# Blu-ray Disc Backup decrypts and copies a Blu-ray filesystem to disk (often more reliable on fussy discs). HandBrake then uses its own main-feature flag if transcoding.
# DVD Backup Extract forces a MakeMKV backup-style extract before HandBrake. MakeMKV backup modes apply to Blu-ray discs.
RIPMETHOD_DVD: # Unused placeholder. DVD ripping follows Rip Method (DVDs use the MKV path unless Rip Method is DVD Backup Extract).
RIPMETHOD_BR: # Unused placeholder. Blu-ray ripping follows Rip Method.
MKV_LANG:
# Language used for MakeMKV audio and subtitle selection.
# This writes MakeMKV's Default selection rule (app_DefaultSelectionString), not Extra Arguments.
# Video streams usually have no language, so Video should stay All video unless you know otherwise.
MKV_VIDEO:
# Which video streams MakeMKV keeps inside each ripped title.
# All video: keep video (recommended). Language-tagged only often matches nothing because video has no language set.
# 3D MVC video is always excluded.
MKV_AUDIO:
# Which audio streams MakeMKV keeps for the selected language.
# Best one: lossless if present, otherwise multi-channel, then stereo. Drops the 2nd and later English (or chosen language) tracks.
# All in this language: keep every matching audio track.
# None: no audio.
MKV_INCLUDE_CORE:
# Keep the lossy HD core (AC3/DTS) that sits beside TrueHD or DTS-HD MA.
# Options: Yes or No.
# No (recommended) avoids two English audio tracks when a lossless track exists.
MKV_EXCLUDE_COMMENTARY:
# Drop commentary and other special audio tracks tagged by MakeMKV.
# Options: Yes or No.
MKV_SUBTITLES:
# Which subtitles MakeMKV keeps for the selected language.
# One + forced: forced subs if present, plus one other subtitle (drops 2nd and later).
# All in this language: every matching subtitle, including SDH.
# Forced only: forced subs only.
# None: no subtitles.
MKV_ARGS:
# Extra arguments passed to makemkvcon on the command line.
# Examples: --profile=/opt/arm/default.mmcp.xml  or  --debug=-stdout
# Do not put -sel: selection rules here. Use Language, Video, Audio, and Subtitles above.
# Leave empty for MakeMKV defaults.
DELRAWFILES:
# Delete files in Raw Rip Folder and Transcode Folder for the job after it completes.
# Options: Yes or No.
HB_PRESET_DVD:
# HandBrake preset name for DVDs.
# Run HandBrakeCLI -z for the full list. Example: HQ 720p30 Surround
HB_PRESET_BD:
# HandBrake preset name for Blu-rays.
# Run HandBrakeCLI -z for the full list. Example: HQ 1080p30 Surround
DEST_EXT:
# File type written by the transcode.
# Options: MKV or MP4.
# Should match what your HandBrake or FFmpeg command actually writes.
HANDBRAKE_CLI: # HandBrake program name or path used for transcoding. Usually HandBrakeCLI.
HANDBRAKE_LOCAL: # HandBrake program for local processing. Keep the same as HandBrake Program unless you offload encodes.
FFMPEG_PRE_FILE_ARGS:
# Extra arguments placed before the input file (before -i).
# Used only when Use Instead of HandBrake is Yes. See ffmpeg -h.
FFMPEG_POST_FILE_ARGS:
# Extra arguments placed after the input file (after -i).
# Used only when Use Instead of HandBrake is Yes.
FFMPEG_CLI:
# Program name or path used when Use Instead of HandBrake is Yes.
# Usually ffmpeg.
FFMPEG_LOCAL:
# Local program used when encodes stay on this machine.
# Keep the same as Program unless you offload encodes.
USE_FFMPEG:
# Transcode with FFmpeg instead of HandBrake.
# Options: Yes or No.
# This is experimental. No uses HandBrakeCLI.
MAINFEATURE:
# Rip only one title from a movie disc instead of every title.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Only applied when the disc is identified as a movie. A poor fit for TV series.
# With Rip Method set to MKV Titles, MakeMKV scans titles then rips one: most chapters, then largest, then longest. That is a guess. Some Blu-rays repeat the movie playlist many times; ARM warns when that looks likely.
# With Rip Method set to Blu-ray Disc Backup, MakeMKV copies the disc and HandBrake's main-feature flag picks the title during transcode.
# Requires libdvdcss2 for some DVDs.
HB_ARGS_DVD:
# Extra HandBrakeCLI arguments for DVDs, appended to the preset.
# Example: --subtitle scan -F
HB_ARGS_BD:
# Extra HandBrakeCLI arguments for Blu-rays.
# Example: --subtitle scan -F --subtitle-burned --audio-lang-list eng --all-audio
EMBY_REFRESH:
# Trigger an Emby library scan after a successful main-feature rip.
# Options: Yes or No.
# Only runs when Main Feature Only is also Yes. Needs the Emby server settings below.
EMBY_SERVER: # Emby hostname or IP address. Leave empty to disable Emby integration.
EMBY_PORT: # Emby HTTP port. Default: 8096. Valid range: 1–65535.
EMBY_CLIENT: # Emby client name sent during API auth. Can be any label, often ARM.
EMBY_DEVICE: # Emby device name sent during API auth. Can be any label.
EMBY_DEVICEID: # Emby device id sent during API auth. Can be any label.
EMBY_USERNAME: # Emby username used to authenticate library scans.
EMBY_USERID: # Emby user id for Emby Username. Find it at http://<server>:<port>/Users/Public
EMBY_PASSWORD:
# SHA1 hex of the Emby password (not the plain password).
# Generate with: echo -n your-password | sha1sum | awk '{print $1}'
EMBY_API_KEY: # Emby API key from the Emby dashboard under Advanced / Security.
NOTIFY_RIP:
# Send a notification when the rip stage finishes.
# Options: Yes or No.
NOTIFY_TRANSCODE:
# Send a notification when transcoding finishes.
# Options: Yes or No.
NOTIFY_JOBID:
# Append the job id to notification titles.
# Options: Yes or No.
PB_KEY: # Pushbullet access token. Leave empty to disable Pushbullet.
IFTTT_KEY: # IFTTT Webhooks key. Leave empty to disable IFTTT.
IFTTT_EVENT: # IFTTT Webhooks event name. Used with IFTTT Key. Default: arm_event.
PO_USER_KEY:
# Pushover user key. Leave empty to disable Pushover.
# Both Pushover User Key and Pushover App Key are required to send.
PO_APP_KEY: # Pushover application or API token. Required with Pushover User Key.
BASH_SCRIPT:
# Optional script run for every notification.
# Invoked as: bash SCRIPT "title" "body"
# Leave empty to disable.
OMDB_API_KEY: # API key from https://omdbapi.com/ used when Metadata Provider is OMDb.
TMDB_API_KEY: # API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/ used when Metadata Provider is TMDb.
JSON_URL:
# Apprise-style JSON webhook URL for notifications.
# http:// is sent as json:// and https:// as jsons://
# Leave empty to disable.
APPRISE:
# Path to apprise.yaml for extra notification services.
# Leave empty to disable. Docker default is often /etc/arm/config/apprise.yaml
index_refresh:
# How often the Home page polls for job updates.
# Unit: milliseconds. Default: 2000 (every 2 seconds).
# Minimum: 500. Use a larger number if the page feels busy.
use_icons:
# Legacy UI option. Stored as true or false.
# The current interface does not switch between icons and text based on this value.
save_remote_images:
# Legacy UI option. Stored as true or false.
# Intended to copy remote posters locally. The current UI does not apply this setting.
bootstrap_skin:
# Legacy Bootswatch theme name (for example spacelab).
# The current UI always uses the dark gold theme, so changing this has no visible effect.
language:
# Legacy UI language code (for example en).
# The current interface is English only.
database_limit:
# Number of rips shown per page on History.
# Must be between 1 and 200. Values over about 175 can make that page slow.
notify_refresh:
# How long UI toast notifications stay on screen.
# Unit: milliseconds. Default: 6500. Avoid values under 1000.
